integrity: Self-contained rigorous proof, two exhaustive implementations, an independent construction validator, and their observed outputs are supplied. No external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof and classification are for standard perfect Roman domination on triangular graphs on at least three root vertices. The stronger zero-neighborhood total-label-sum=2 edge variant, other Johnson ranks, and the all-weight polynomial are not determined here. The exact historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Matching rigidity of perfect Roman domination on triangular graphs
